description: This file defines the SeoMetaSettingsHandler class, which extends ContentHandlerBase to manage SEO metadata aspects for content items in OrchardCore. It retrieves site and social meta settings, constructs URLs, and populates SEO-related properties such as OpenGraph, Twitter, and schema data.

classes.name: SeoMetaSettingsHandler
classes.description: Handles SEO meta settings for content items, populating SEO aspects such as OpenGraph, Twitter, and schema data based on site and social meta configurations.

methods.name: SeoMetaSettingsHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for handling SEO meta settings.

methods.name: GetContentItemAspectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously populates SEO aspects for a content item, including URLs, images, descriptions, and social media metadata.
